findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_product" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_studio_options" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products, get_product, list_collections, get_order_status, set_user_prefs, get_saved_addresses, get_order_preview · Public sink: list_collections, get_order_status, get_saved_addresses, prepare_order, get_studio_status · Destructive: remove_promo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products, get_product, list_collections, get_order_status, set_user_prefs, get_saved_addresses, get_order_preview · Public sink: list_collections, get_order_status, get_saved_addresses, prepare_order, get_studio_status · Destructive: remove_promo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
